acceptance_predicates.description: asb project init serializes channel=dev for every new project, and a compatible legacy channel-less project resolves to dev only through the documented configuration-compatibility path.

Every executable public ASB command family receives the one shared resolved project channel, including project/config, catalog/discovery, provider/agent/model, tool/workload, plan/run/sweep, report/compare, record/replay, easy, control/serve, and TUI commands.
An explicit --channel applies to exactly one invocation without silently rewriting project configuration; explicit configuration change persists across a fresh process.
Malformed, unknown, stable, nightly, and experimental channel values are typed unavailable diagnostics in this development build and never silently fall back.

Human-default output and explicit --json output expose the resolved channel and typed diagnostics whenever channel affects selection, an artifact, an operation, or a failure; help, version, and completion remain usable outside a project without mutation.
Missing authentication, signatures, and key management remain visible development-only warnings and never block dev.

definition_of_done: Exact current-head ASB command-surface tests pass for fresh init, legacy compatibility, every command-family context handoff, override, persistence, restart, unavailable values, and help/version/completion outside a project.
Independent review and hosted checks pass with no secret-shaped output.

inputs.description: Typed channel persisted in the versioned ASB project configuration.
Optional invocation-only --channel override from a supported ASB command.
dev, stable, nightly, and experimental channel identities.

outputs.description: One typed channel context supplied to every executable public command.
Human and JSON typed diagnostics for malformed, unknown, or unavailable channels.

gates.description: A command-surface inventory and tests prove each executable public command receives the shared resolved channel.
Unavailable or malformed explicit and configured channels never silently resolve to another channel.
Project initialization and deliberate configuration changes persist their channel across a fresh process; invocation overrides do not mutate project configuration.
